claims.sentence: A meta-analysis of 28 studies of medical journal articles estimated that about a quarter of quotations contained an error, about half of them major \citep{jergas2015quotation}, and an update covering 46 studies and some 32,000 quotations put the rate at 16.9\%, with no improvement over time \citep{baethge2025quotation}.
claims.claim: Updated meta-analysis of 46 studies / ~32,000 quotations: 16.9% quotation error rate, no improvement over time.
claims.excerpt: identified 46 studies analyzing 32,000 quotations/references. ... Results 16.9% (95% CI: 14.1%-20.0%) of quotations were incorrect, with approximately half classified as major errors (8.0% [95% CI: 6.4%-10.0%]). ... Meta-regression showed no significant improvement in quotation accuracy over recent years ... Conclusions Quotation errors remain a problem in the medical literature, with no improvement over time.
